cues.en: This section of the course is about using Python to understand concepts in trigonometry.
cues.zh: 本章要用 Python 理解三角學的概念。

cues.en: However, before we get into trigonometry Persay, I want to have a video to introduce you to random
cues.zh: 不過，正式進入三角學之前，先用一段影片介紹隨機，

cues.en: numbers and generating random numbers in Python, in particular, random numbers with different kinds of distributions that you get to specify the parameters of.
cues.zh: 數，以及如何在 Python 產生隨機數，尤其是不同分布、可以自行指定參數的隨機數。

cues.en: So it turns out that there are different distributions, that random numbers can be drawn from here, I'm illustrating to these are probably the two kinds of distributions that are most often used when
cues.zh: 隨機數能從不同分布抽取，這裡展示兩種，大概是產生，

cues.en: generating random numbers.
cues.zh: 隨機數時最常用的分布。

cues.en: So these two are typically called the normal distribution, also sometimes called the Gaussian or the bell shaped curve.
cues.zh: 這個通常叫常態分布，也叫高斯分布、鐘形曲線。

cues.en: But I will call them a normal distribution because that's also how they are referred to in Python.
cues.zh: 這裡用常態分布這個名稱，Python 也這樣稱呼。

cues.en: And then we have the uniform distribution, which is shown here in orange.
cues.zh: 另一個是均勻分布，圖中橘色部分。

cues.en: So what do these shapes mean?
cues.zh: 這些形狀代表什麼？

cues.en: So let's start by talking about this blue line, the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 先談藍線，也就是常態分布。

cues.en: So this shape means that if you draw random numbers from a normal distribution, you are more likely
cues.zh: 這個形狀表示，從常態分布抽隨機數，較有可能，

cues.en: to randomly get numbers that are close to zero and you are less likely to get numbers that are close to, let's say, minus two or plus two.
cues.zh: 抽到接近 0 的數字，比較不容易抽到接近例如 -2 或正 2 的數字。

cues.en: So this curve shows the probability of drawing a number at random, given this value now, this function
cues.zh: 這條曲線顯示隨機抽到各個值的可能性，這個函數，

cues.en: never actually gets to zero, but it gets really, really, really close to zero.
cues.zh: 永遠不會真正到 0，但會非常非常接近 0。

cues.en: So if you are drawing numbers randomly from a normal distribution, it's possible to get a number of minus four or value around minus four.
cues.zh: 所以從常態分布隨機抽數字，可能得到 -4，或接近 -4 的值。

cues.en: But it's really, really unlikely.
cues.zh: 只是機率非常低。

cues.en: So you can see that this distribution is centered at zero and that means that the numbers close to zero are most likely to be picked.
cues.zh: 這個分布以 0 為中心，代表接近 0 的數字最容易被選中。

cues.en: Now, it's possible to push this distribution around, to have this center value be, for example,
cues.zh: 也可以把分布平移，讓中心例如變成，

cues.en: 17 if you want to draw numbers randomly with a center of 17 and in Python, I will show you how to shift this distribution and also how to modulate the width of this distribution.
cues.zh: 17，抽到以 17 為中心的隨機數。會在 Python 示範如何平移，以及調整分布寬度。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's for a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 這是常態分布。

cues.en: Then we have a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 再來是均勻分布。

cues.en: And that means that if you draw numbers randomly from a uniform distribution, you are equally likely
cues.zh: 代表從均勻分布隨機抽數字時，

cues.en: to get numbers that fall between the values of zero and one, and the probability of getting a number larger than one or less than zero is zero.
cues.zh: 0 到 1 之間各處的機會相同，而大於 1、小於 0 的機率是 0。

cues.en: So you can draw numbers from a uniform distribution until the cows come home and you will never get
cues.zh: 所以從這個均勻分布一直抽、抽到天荒地老，也不會得到，

cues.en: a value of minus one because this probability density here, this orange line is zero below zero.
cues.zh: -1，因為這條橘色機率密度線，在 0 以下是 0。

cues.en: Now, that said, it's also possible to change this uniform distribution so that you shift it on the x axis and stretch it around to change the width of the distribution.
cues.zh: 不過，也能沿 x 軸平移、拉伸，改變這個均勻分布的寬度。

cues.en: OK, so let's now switch to Python and I will illustrate these concepts to you.
cues.zh: 切到 Python，示範這些概念。

cues.zh: 會用 NumPy、Matplotlib，先產生隨機，

cues.zh: 數。用一個變數接住，再寫 np.random.rand。

cues.zh: 你在自己電腦執行，不會得到 7877，

cues.zh: 反覆執行，每次都會得到不同數字。

cues.zh: 這是單一數字，想產生例如兩個隨機數，就在輸入寫 2，現在得到兩個。

cues.zh: 產生 1000 個隨機數。

cues.zh: 不把它們全部直接顯示。

cues.en: I'm going to print them out.
cues.zh: 而是畫出來。

cues.zh: plt.plot，畫這些數字，用正方形標記。

cues.en: And let's already just have a quick look and see what this looks like.
cues.zh: 快速看看外觀。

cues.en: OK, so it looks like a unorganized cloud of dots, which is exactly what it should look like.
cues.zh: 像一團沒有規則的點雲，正是應有的樣子。

cues.en: These are randomly drawn numbers.
cues.zh: 這些是隨機抽取的數字。

cues.en: And you can also see on the Y axis that they all go between zero and one.
cues.zh: y 軸也看得到，全部介於 0 和 1。

cues.en: So that shows you that this Rande function is generating from a uniform distribution between zero and one.
cues.zh: 說明 rand 從 0 到 1 的均勻分布產生數字。

cues.en: So there's another way we can look at this, which is through something called a histogram.
cues.zh: 也能用另一種方式看，叫直方圖。

cues.en: So I'm going to use the function hest and peel to show.
cues.zh: 用 hist 函數，再 plt.show。

cues.en: So here is the histogram of these numbers.
cues.zh: 這是數字的直方圖。

cues.en: Now, these two plots have the same data.
cues.zh: 兩張圖的資料相同。

cues.en: They come from the same data, but they show the data in a slightly different way.
cues.zh: 來自同一組資料，只是呈現方式不同。

cues.en: So here you see the values on the Y axis and the ordinal position on the x axis.
cues.zh: 這裡 y 軸顯示數值，x 軸是依序的位置。

cues.en: Here you see the values on the x axis.
cues.zh: 這裡 x 軸顯示數值。

cues.en: So this X axis here corresponds to the Y axis here and here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡 x 軸對應那裡 y 軸，而這裡，

cues.en: The Y axis corresponds to count.
cues.zh: y 軸對應個數。

cues.en: So the way that you interpret this histogram is that there are about 85 numbers between the values of
cues.zh: 解讀直方圖的方法，是有大約 85 個數字，介於，

cues.en: zero and whatever this ends up being, I guess that's probably zero point one.
cues.zh: 0 和這個值之間，我猜大概是 0.1。

cues.en: So that means if you would look here, count all these dots that are between zero and point one, there are going to be around 85 of them.
cues.zh: 也就是回頭數這裡 0 到 0.1 之間的點，會有大約 85 個。

cues.en: Now, you might be a little bit surprised to see this histogram the shape of this histogram, because
cues.zh: 這個直方圖的形狀，可能讓你有點意外，因為，

cues.en: I said in the slides a moment ago that a uniform distribution means you are equally likely to draw a number between zero and one.
cues.zh: 剛才投影片說，均勻分布代表 0 到 1 之間，各處抽取機會相同。

cues.en: And this doesn't look like equal likelihood.
cues.zh: 這看起來並不相同。

cues.en: But the thing to keep in mind is that these are randomly generated numbers.
cues.zh: 但要記得，數字是隨機產生的。

cues.en: So there's going to be some variability.
cues.zh: 所以會有一些變動。

cues.en: And purely by chance, there's going to be, you know, some range that's a little bit more likely to be drawn than another range.
cues.zh: 純粹出於機會，某個範圍可能抽得比另一個稍多。

cues.en: But this is not systematic.
cues.zh: 但不是系統性的差異。

cues.en: So you can see now it looks like there's a bulge in this distribution at around point four.
cues.zh: 現在看來，分布在 0.4 附近有個凸起。

cues.en: But if I run this again, you can see, well, OK, still maybe a tiny bit of a bulge here.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，好，這裡似乎仍稍微凸起。

cues.en: Let's run it again.
cues.zh: 再執行。

cues.en: OK, here you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Now, if anything, there's a bit of a dip here around point four and there's maybe more values up here.
cues.zh: 現在反而在 0.4 附近稍微凹下，這邊可能更多值。

cues.en: So you can see that each time you run this code, each time you generate new random numbers, it's going to look a little bit different.
cues.zh: 每次執行、重新產生隨機數，外觀都會稍微不同。

cues.en: But in general, the shape of the distribution will be the same.
cues.zh: 但整體分布形狀相同。

cues.en: So this distribution is always varying between zero and one.
cues.zh: 這個分布始終介於 0 和 1。

cues.en: But what if you want to generate random numbers outside of this range or in some different range?
cues.zh: 若想產生範圍以外，或其他範圍的隨機數呢？

cues.en: So to do that, you need to shift and then possibly also stretch this distribution.
cues.zh: 需要平移，也可能要拉伸分布。

cues.en: So, for example, let's say I want this distribution to be centered at three instead of being centered at zero point five.
cues.zh: 例如，希望中心是 3，而不是 0.5。

cues.en: So then I say nums equals nums plus three.
cues.zh: 寫 nums=nums+3。

cues.en: So now I'm just adding three to the entire distribution.
cues.zh: 就是整個分布加 3。

cues.en: So when I run this code again, now you see that this distribution, which originally varied between zero and one.
cues.zh: 再執行，原本介於 0 和 1 的分布，

cues.en: Now it varies between three and four.
cues.zh: 現在介於 3 和 4。

cues.en: And you can also see that in the histogram there are no values, less than three, no values greater than four.
cues.zh: 直方圖也看得出，沒有小於 3 或大於 4 的值。

cues.en: And the values between zero and or between three and four are basically equally likely to be generated.
cues.zh: 0 到，應該說 3 到 4 之間，各值基本上機會相同。

cues.en: So here you see some different examples of histograms for rerunning this code.
cues.zh: 這裡是重新執行後，幾個不同直方圖例子。

cues.en: Now it turns out that for a uniform distribution, there's a pretty simple formula.
cues.zh: 對均勻分布，有個很簡單的公式。

cues.en: There's a pretty simple algorithm for getting the minimum and maximum values to be whatever you want them to be.
cues.zh: 很簡單的演算法，讓最小值、最大值成為任何你想要的值。

cues.en: So let me show you how that works.
cues.zh: 來示範。

cues.en: I will say Min Val.
cues.zh: 先寫 minval，

cues.en: So this is going to be variable.
cues.zh: 這是一個變數。

cues.en: Let's say we want numbers to go from two to 17, 17.
cues.zh: 假設想要 2 到 17 的數字。

cues.en: So how can we change this distribution, which initially comes out varying from zero to one to a distribution that varies between two and 17.
cues.zh: 怎麼把原本介於 0 和 1 的分布，變成介於 2 和 17？

cues.en: So the formula is you say nums equals.
cues.zh: 公式是 nums 等於，

cues.en: So first you generate the uniformly distributed random numbers and then you multiply them by the difference
cues.zh: 先產生均勻分布的隨機數，再乘上，

cues.en: between the max of Max, Val and Min Val and then add.
cues.zh: 最大值 maxval 和最小值 minval 的差，再加。

cues.en: Actually, let me just start right there with this.
cues.zh: 先做到這裡。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is taking this set of numbers that ranges between zero and one and I'm multiplying
cues.zh: 這裡是拿 0 到 1 之間的數字，乘上，

cues.en: it or stretching it out so that it varies now between zero and 15 and it's going to vary between zero
cues.zh: 一個值、把它拉伸，現在變成 0 到 15，因為，

cues.en: and 15 because the smallest number here is going to be or the smallest possible number will be zero.
cues.zh: 最小的可能數字是 0。

cues.en: So zero times this is still going to be zero.
cues.zh: 0 乘這個，仍是 0。

cues.en: And then the largest number is going to be or the largest possible number is one.
cues.zh: 最大值，或最大的可能數字是 1。

cues.en: And so that will get multiplied by 15, which is 17 minus two.
cues.zh: 會乘上 15，也就是 17 減 2。

cues.en: So let's have a look at how this looks so far.
cues.zh: 看看目前外觀。

cues.en: So you can see now we have numbers between zero and 15.
cues.zh: 數字現在介於 0 和 15。

cues.en: You see that also in the histogram here.
cues.zh: 直方圖也看得到。

cues.en: And then to get it to go from between two and 17, we add to this distribution the minimum value.
cues.zh: 要變成 2 到 17，再對這個分布加上最小值。

cues.en: So now we get numbers that very randomly that are drawn randomly from a distribution with a minimum of two and a maximum of 17.
cues.zh: 現在得到從最小 2、最大 17 的分布中，隨機抽取的數字。

cues.en: So this is about creating a uniformly distributed set of random numbers.
cues.zh: 這是建立均勻分布隨機數的方法。
